name: Globe-ing Inc.
summary: Globe-ing Inc. provides DX and strategic consulting services in Japan. The company operates through Business Operations and AI Business segments. It offers AI platforms including Implicit Knowledge Platform; AI Spend Intelligence for procurement; Globing-kun, an AI consultant for business infrastructure know-how; and AI Meeting Minute Consultant (AIMeE) for advanced meeting management. The company also provides consulting services for corporate finance and strategy; automotive products/ pharma and health care; technology, media and telecommunications; and chemical and utility industries.
